title: Live interfaces and session traffic
description: Rates use the actual sample interval; totals begin when CoreRobin launches.

connections.title: Active connections
connections.description: Updated every {{seconds}} seconds; process ownership is shown when the operating system reports it, while connections remain visible when permission is limited.
connections.truncated: Only the first 500 scanned entries are shown.
connections.skipped: {{count}} connection entries could not be read due to system restrictions.

attribution.available: The system can report process ownership for connections.
attribution.partial: System permissions may prevent process attribution for some connections.
attribution.unavailable: Process attribution is unavailable on this platform.

quality.title: Network quality
quality.description: Check DNS, connection latency, jitter, packet loss, and connectivity.
quality.empty: No quality check has run yet. CoreRobin does not probe continuously in the background.
quality.method: Latency and loss are estimated with six TCP connection probes; no privileged raw packets are used.

history.title: Connection history and aggregation
history.description: Review longer-term connection activity by application or domain.
history.optIn: Connection history can include application names, domains, and remote IPs, so it is off by default. When enabled, it stays on this device.
history.lookupFallback: Some names could not be resolved; IP addresses were recorded instead.
history.empty: Waiting for the next active connection scan.
history.privacy: Stores five-minute aggregates only, capped at 5,000 entries; disable or clear at any time.
